title: Epic nighttime siege and destructible walls in my top-down strategy game! (Workflow included)
author: sharbelito
selftext:
Hey everyone, I wanted to share some gameplay from a medieval strategy game I'm developing called Beyond The Rhine.  
  
This clip shows a full-scale nighttime assault on a fortified circular castle. I've been focusing heavily on the combat mechanics and destructible environments... you can see the explosive fireball spells completely blasting apart the stone walls, towers, and interior buildings to open up breach points for the infantry. The UI also shows the unit formation controls as I maneuver archers and cavalry to swarm the gap.

I'd love to hear your feedback on the siege engine impacts and the overall visual atmosphere of the assault. Happy to answer any questions about the game or my AI workflow!

i have a youtube channel called "Beyond The Rhine" for videos and progress
